system.omamori:
Enchant a weapon you are touching (or if you are a Dosojin you may enchant your servant’s claws, teeth, etc) with divine energy. Whenever the weapon is used against a supernatural creature it may deal either its regular damage or Spirit damage, whichever would result in a better result. This enhancement lasts till your next rest, till you enchant another weapon that causes you to exceed your maximum number of enchantments, or till you are slain.

At Arcane Might I you may only enchant a single weapon with this effect with the effect on the previous weapon ending if you exchant another, at Arcane Might III you may enchant a maximum of ten weapons, at Arcane Might V you may enhance a hundred.
system.ofuda: Grant the blessing described at the previous level and additionally these weapons deal an additional amount of Spirit damage equal to your Arcane Might when used against supernatural creatures.
